first.rationale: Onboarding completion has declined 4% QoQ and activation is also down. Simplifying onboarding directly addresses the completion decline and has prior evidence of improving time-to-value and early adoption, which supports sustainable qualified revenue. Activation messaging is a credible alternative and should be verified alongside the onboarding record before commitment. Promotional pricing may counter the competitor but prior evidence indicates a material 30-day retention cost, so it is not appropriate as the default long-term revenue action without a tightly constrained exception.

final.rationale: Run a standard experiment simplifying onboarding. It directly addresses the 4% QoQ decline in completion and, in the verified prior experiment, increased completion by 13%, reduced time-to-value by 2.1 days, and improved 30-day retention by 3%. This is the strongest demonstrated fit for sustainable qualified revenue. Activation messaging remains a validated follow-up option for the activation decline, while promotional pricing carries a known retention trade-off.
